title: AI-assisted Unity sheepdog game — Android testers needed
author: Special-Recover7587
selftext:
Hey folks! After about eight months of work, I’ve finally reached the Google Play closed-testing stage with my first game.

It’s called *Working Dawg: Eildon Trials*, a sheepdog puzzle game developed with support from ChatGPT and Meshy. AI has been a lifesaver for the coding side, while Meshy has helped with character creation, rigging and animation.

I’m looking for a few Android testers who can remain opted in for 14 days and provide honest feedback.

I’m happy to return the favour for other developers in the same boat!

[https://eildon-trials-game.liam-twin.chatgpt.site](https://eildon-trials-game.liam-twin.chatgpt.site/)

  
Feedback can be submitted through the private form on the website.

Interested? Please send me a DM. 🐾

comments.author: Special-Recover7587
comments.body:
Promise this isnt spam.   Happy to show privacy policy.  The game doesnt need any special pernisions.   Its just a casual game developed with my kids that we were hoping to launch.  

Thanks very much folks for taking the time to read this. 

Good luck with your own projects
